# kala_task (Data Source)

Looks up one task (checklist item) within a case, by id or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Set exactly one of id or name. `name` is narrowed upstream via nameContains,
# then matched exactly; two matches is an error rather than a silent first-wins.

data "kala_task" "by_name" {
  case_id = 1
  name    = "Mount gutter"
}

data "kala_task" "by_id" {
  case_id = 1
  id      = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `case_id` (Number) The case the task belongs to. Required: Kala addresses checklist items by case.

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Look up by checklist item id. Set exactly one of `id` or `name`.
- `include_contact_details` (Boolean) Expose assignee and authorship fields. Off by default.
- `include_financials` (Boolean) Expose hours and price fields. Off by default.
- `name` (String) Look up by exact task name. Narrowed upstream via `nameContains` before matching. Set exactly one of `id` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `assigned_to_me` (Boolean) Whether the task is assigned to the authenticating user. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- this identifies a person.
- `assignee_worker_nr` (Number) Employee number of the responsible worker. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- this identifies a person. Null also when unassigned.
- `billed_hours` (Number) Hours billed. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `case_number` (String) The case number, e.g. `KA-1`.
- `checklist_id` (Number) The checklist this item belongs to.
- `created_by` (String) Who created the task. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- this identifies a person.
- `deadline` (String) Deadline as RFC 3339. Null when unset.
- `description` (String) Task description.
- `finished_by` (String) Who completed the task. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- this identifies a person.
- `has_image` (Boolean) Whether a photo has been attached.
- `image_required` (Boolean) Whether completing the task requires a photo.
- `invoice_mode` (String) How the task is invoiced, e.g. `REG_HOURS&SPECIAL`.
- `is_finished` (Boolean) Whether the task is complete.
- `note_required` (Boolean) Whether completing the task requires a note.
- `price_fixed` (Number) Fixed price, when one is set. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `registered_hours_total` (Number) Hours registered against the task. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `status_name` (String) Status label. **Not translated** -- these are the tenant's own values from the company-wide `kanban_options` setting, so they appear in whatever language that setting uses.
- `time_added` (String) When the task was created, as RFC 3339.
- `time_finished` (String) When it was completed, as RFC 3339. Null when unfinished.
